$comment: THE one declaration of which instance is CONTROL for the platform deploy (policies platform-deploy-control-first and control-always-latest; Doc/Architecture/PlatformAndModuleDeploy). `url` is the public base URL whose /api/version and /health the arming (`arm-promoted-set.py select`) and the alarm (`control-always-latest.yml`) read; it is the instance on the `memex-control` image line, which `Deploy control first` tags for every accepted platform build. `platformLagBoundMinutes` is how long control may run an older platform than the newest build it was given before the alarm goes RED — one control-first handover plus a routed roll with its migration Job, measured from the FIRST build control was given and did not take; tighten it once measured rolls justify it. At the control-plane cutover (Systemorph/Memex `control` record, §8 step 6) this file does not change: it already names the memex-control instance.
